question: Which one of the following diseases is caused mainly by the deficiency of Vitamin C?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scurvy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** medical term** for a **vitamin C deficiency** is **scurvy.**
 
• **Anaemia, tiredness, spontaneous bleeding, limb pain, swelling **in some areas of the body, and occasionally **gum ulcers and tooth loss **might result from it.
 
• This is because **vitamin C i**s required for the **production of collagen**, a crucial element in **connective tissues**.
 
• In the body, connective tissues are necessary for** support and structure, **particularly the **construction of blood vessels.**
 
• A lack of vitamin C will also affect the **immune system, iron absorption, cholesterol metabolism, and other functions.**
 
• Treatment entails giving patients **oral or intravenous vitamin C supplements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rickets:**

 
 
• It is a condition that affects **bone development in children.**
 
• The cause of rickets is a lack of vitamin D or calcium in a child's diet.
 
 
 
• **Goitre:**
 
 
• It is a** lump or swelling** at the front of the neck caused by a** swollen thyroid. **
 
• It is caused mainly by the deficiency of** iodine** in the diet.
 
 
 
• **Kwashiorkor:**
 
 
• It is a condition resulting from** inadequate protein intake.**
